text: You pay income tax when you earn. And you pay GST again when you spend.
Say your salary is fifteen lakh rupees a year.
Under the new tax regime, after the seventy five thousand rupee standard deduction, your income tax with cess is ninety seven thousand, five hundred.
That leaves about one lakh, sixteen thousand, eight hundred and seventy five rupees a month.
Now you buy a forty three inch TV for thirty thousand rupees.
Eighteen percent GST is already inside that price. That's four thousand, five hundred and seventy six rupees.
Spend one lakh a year on eighteen percent items, and about fifteen thousand of it is GST.
Some relief: since September twenty twenty five, milk, paneer and health insurance carry zero GST.
Earn, tax. Spend, tax again. Is it fair? Comment TAX and tell me.
